Re-verified: the flag does not introduce a new error path or change this behavior at all (asserted equal to the no-flag case). text: r2 regression guard (not in the groomed AC ledger; added after QA found r1's mock accepted an Autotask request shape the real API rejects, comment 90170265051691): Given includeUserDefinedFields: true, When autotask_search_contacts builds its Autotask request, Then that request never carries IncludeFields at all (so it cannot trigger Autotask's real HTTP 500 'Unable to find userDefinedFields in the Contact Entity'); and the mock itself is verified to reproduce that real HTTP 500 when something does send IncludeFields:['userDefinedFields'], so this guard would catch a future regression from any call site, not just today's
